question: Where do worshippers become fully established in relation to supreme Shiva?
premises: Supreme Shiva is called full in nature to that extent.
His fullness is understood through these powers.
Worshippers become directly and fully established right there.
inference: Direct establishment in supreme Shiva occurs in the very fullness expressed through his powers.
plain_english: To that extent this supreme Shiva is called of full nature; therefore worshippers are directly and fully established right there.
